channel.title: Detours by Tony Abdelmalak
channel.description: Notes from a career that didn't go in a straight line.

item.title: Follow the work, not the title
item.description: Why I left full-time roles for consulting, and how each contract pulled me closer to building.

item.title: The question I used to dread
item.description: What were you doing between May and December 2021? For years I had no good answer. Here's the one I'd give now.

item.title: Same conversation, other side of the table
item.description: I went from selling to physicians to recruiting for NBCUniversal and HBO. It took me years to see it was one job.
